title: feat: add collapsible sidebar
description:
## Goal
Improve map workspace usage and mobile responsiveness by making the left sidebar collapsible.

## Requirements
- Add a control to collapse and expand the left sidebar.
- Let the map occupy the freed space when the sidebar is collapsed.
- On mobile, present the sidebar as a bottom sheet.
- Preserve the sidebar state where appropriate.
- Support keyboard interaction and accessible labels.
- Keep route creation, editing, and point dragging functional in both states.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Sidebar can be opened and closed with one action.
- [ ] Map resizes correctly after sidebar state changes.
- [ ] Mobile layout uses a bottom sheet without permanently covering the map.
- [ ] State transitions do not cause visible layout jumps.
- [ ] Existing route workflows continue to work without regressions.
- [ ] Controls are accessible by keyboard and have accessible names.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Implementation follows existing UI/component conventions.
- [ ] Relevant tests are added or updated.
- [ ] Existing test suite passes.
- [ ] No regression in desktop or mobile layouts.
